Efficiency.q: What is the formula for efficiency?
Efficiency.a: Useful output energy divided by total input energy
d: Total input energy divided by useful output energy
Wasted energy divided by total input energy

Efficiency.q: Can efficiency ever be greater than 1 (or 100%)?
Efficiency.a: No - this would violate conservation of energy

Efficiency.q: How can efficiency be improved in a machine?
Efficiency.a: By reducing friction and heat loss

Specific Heat Capacity.a: Q = mcAT (energy = mass x SHC x temperature change)

Specific Heat Capacity.q: Why is water used in central heating systems?
Specific Heat Capacity.a: Water has a high specific heat capacity so stores a lot of energy

Water has a low boiling point
